{{Quote|You are the individual designated "Barsen'thor" by the Jedi Council. This rank indicates a supreme level of trust.|[[MP-77]], to the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] of the Cold War|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Barsen'thor''' was a ceremonial rank in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] that originated as a [[Cerean (language)|Cerean]] word meaning "'''Warden of the Order'''."

==Overview==
First bestowed posthumously upon [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Lorjan Sakku]] by his [[Lorjan Sakku's Jedi Master|Master]] after he defeated his own brother [[Lyhesh Sakku|Lyhesh]] and redeemed him at the cost of his own life, the title was adopted by the Order and given only to exceptional [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. By the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Barsen'thor (second)|only one other individual]] had been given the title, and the [[The Barsen'thor|apprentice]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yuon Par]] was named the Barsen'thor after the defeat and redemption of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Parkanas Tark|Vivicar]].<ref name="TORE" />
